assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a photorealistic studio equipment photo for an actual HTML fitness interface, NOT a UI mockup.
Input image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the equipment identity, mechanical anatomy, materials, perspective and soft studio light.
Primary request: Change ONLY the framing/zoom. Zoom the camera out so the SAME full lat-pulldown machine fits centrally within the photograph, occupying exactly 60–62% of the total canvas HEIGHT, not 90%. Preserve the entire machine including the overhead arm, hanging wide pull bar, black seat, cylindrical thigh rollers, weight-stack tower, silver/black frame and all base feet. Maintain the same three-quarter perspective and proportions. Place the full equipment silhouette inside the central horizontal band from 20% to 81% of canvas height, with generous neutral studio background ABOVE and BELOW the equipment. The object must be centered vertically at 50% canvas height and centered horizontally at 50% canvas width. On a 1536 × 1024 landscape canvas, the equipment should extend approximately from y=205 to y=829, leaving around 200px clear background at top and bottom. This geometry is critical: the eventual browser display uses object-fit:cover at 320 × 144, which crops the top/bottom, so every part of the machine MUST fit in the central 62% vertical band.
Scene/backdrop: extend the existing bright, seamless light warm-gray studio backdrop and pale floor to fill the entire canvas edge-to-edge. Soft silver side-light from upper-left, subtle realistic contact shadow. No dark room, no new objects, no decorative background. Preserve the lighting/material appearance of the target.
Style: refined photorealistic grayscale studio product photograph, black padding with polished metal highlights.
Constraints: exactly same machine and camera angle, full equipment uncut and unwarped, landscape canvas 1536 × 1024, opaque light-neutral background across full canvas, no transparent areas, no person, no added equipment, no text/numbers/logos/borders/UI/phone. Change only camera zoom and empty surrounding space.
assets.inspection: Full same lat-pulldown silhouette is centered in approximately the middle 60% of the canvas height; upper arm, wide pull bar, seat, thigh rollers, weight stack and all base feet visible. Empty light studio canvas fills all four edges. No image postprocessing.
